result.title: Graph Serializations for Reasoning LLMs: A Study Across Knowledge Extraction and Structural Reasoning
result.summary: The way a knowledge graph is serialized as text for inclusion into LLM context can substantially affect downstream LLM performance, with prior work reporting tens of percentage points variations across formats. However, existing studies consider only a limited set of representations and predate frontier reasoning models, which now offer stronger reasoning, instruction-following, and long-context capabilities. We evaluate 15 graph representation formats across nine frontier LLM configurations on ontology-based knowledge extraction and structural graph reasoning tasks. While knowledge extraction is relatively insensitive to different serialization formats, the choice of the optimal format for structural reasoning tasks significantly affects accuracy. We demonstrate that the optimal representation choice depends on model, query, and task and propose to approach graph serialization as a dynamic orchestration decision.

AI.brief_summary: 在九个前沿 LLM 配置上评测 15 种知识图谱序列化格式，发现知识抽取对格式不敏感，而结构化图推理的准确率显著依赖格式，且最优格式随模型、查询和任务而变，据此提出把序列化视为动态编排决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「同一内容以何种形式进入上下文会改变推理表现」的结论与按模型、查询动态选择表示的方法线索，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据如何序列化进上下文或保留为 latent 状态；但该文仅涉纯文本图表示，无视觉模态与 latent 状态，迁移属推测。
